description: For a website: who stands behind a request an agent sent, and how they stand. Pass the request exactly as it arrived (method, full URL, headers including Signature, Signature-Input and Signature-Agent). `result` is one of four: `verified` (a Pidgeon operator’s agent: `valid` true, with the operator and its reputation), `signed_known` (signed with a key from an outside directory on Pidgeon’s recognised list, named in `signature_agent.operator`; not verified by Pidgeon), `signed_unknown` (signed with a key from an outside directory nobody vouches for) or `refused` (unsigned, a bad signature, expired, revoked or replayed; `reason` says which). Only `refused` is a refusal. Every answer also says what the site rule for the `place` decided: `decision` (`allow`, `limit`, `block`, or `watch` with `would`) and `rule`, one line saying why.

place.description: Where on the site the agent is, for the site rule; `other` by default.
